root_cause: The product had already committed the exact P1 pending event before M44. P4-AS incorrectly required the pending slot to be empty, so it did not add the missing verified-surface receipt. Without that receipt authority, the P4-AR view adapter did not use the actual applied plan.
authorized_correction: Allow only an absent pending event or an exact pre-existing event matching prediction_id, policy_id, turn_index, and input_digest. Preserve the exact pending event and ledger byte-for-byte and add only the missing M44 receipt. Any mismatch remains fail-closed.
